---
title: "Calibrated scale measurement"
---

::: {.status-box .status-complete}
**Status: Production**

Reviewed for MethodMesh native use and ODK intent launch. This is a production
capability, not a formal clinical validation claim.
:::

## Purpose

Collect a calibrated visual analogue or numeric range measurement using a physical line length. The calibration allows onscreen display to be an exact representation of real world size. For instance, after calibration a 50mm scale will appear as exactly 50mm on the screen.

## Capability IDs

- `calibrated_scale`

## Requirements

- Screen dimensions and display suitable for the requested physical scale. Global calibration of screen pixel:mm resolution.

## Supported XLSForm calls

**From `example_odk_calibrated_scale.xlsx`:**

``` text
com.example.methodmesh.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='calibrated_scale',input_prompt='Rate your pain',input_hint='0 means no pain; 100 means the worst pain you can imagine',input_vas_length_mm='50',return_mode='flat')
```

**From `example_odk_calibrated_scale_MinMax.xlsx`:**

``` text
com.example.methodmesh.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='calibrated_scale',input_prompt='Rate your pain',input_hint='0 means no pain; 100 means the worst pain you can imagine',input_vas_length_mm='50',input_minimum='0',input_maximum='10',return_mode='flat')
```

**From `example_odk_calibrated_scale_Range.xlsx`:**

``` text
com.example.methodmesh.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='calibrated_scale',input_prompt='Rate your pain',input_hint='0 means no pain; 100 means the worst pain you can imagine',input_vas_length_mm='50',input_use_range='true',input_lower_label='Least pain',input_upper_label='Worst pain',return_mode='flat')
```

**From `example_odk_calibrated_scale_Vertical.xlsx`:**

``` text
com.example.methodmesh.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='calibrated_scale',input_prompt='Rate your pain',input_hint='0 means no pain; 100 means the worst pain you can imagine',input_vas_length_mm='50',input_vertical_mode='true',return_mode='flat')
```

## Inputs observed in supplied examples

| Field | Label | XLSForm type |
|-------|-------|--------------|
| start |       | start        |

## Expected returned fields

Core return is intentionally compact.

- single scale: `value`
- range/two-scale mode: `lower_value`, `upper_value`

Audit and full JSON payload modes include the configuration needed to interpret
the measurement: `minimum`, `maximum`, `use_range`, `scale_length_mm`,
`scale_length_dp`, `dp_per_mm`, and `vertical_mode`.
